fusions.name: Smothering Embrace
fusions.desc: Wraps the target in a heavy blanket and crushes it for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Midwinter Weight
fusions.desc: Drops a heavy quilt on every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Damped] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Den Bedding
fusions.desc: Burrows into heavy bedding, restoring 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilted Hide
fusions.desc: Conjures a thick quilted coat: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12% and your maximum health by 10.
